rationale: Ensuring the cell remains well-formed after set is provable and avoids the type-mismatch with old(self.predicate()). It documents that internal invariants (e.g., the stored-permission pairing and pcell id) are preserved by set without asserting equality of the predicate value by value.
risks: Weaker than the original intent: does not state the predicate object itself is unchanged.
May be seen as trivial if wf is already maintained by type invariants, but it is safe and checkable given the old() typing issue.
